about: The controllers openDJ looks after itself, beyond running Mixxx's mappings. beta: works on paper, waiting for someone to try it on the hardware. supported: tried on the hardware and its mapping settled. planned: no mapping yet. HID mappings (.hid.xml) are all script: their picture says what each control does, and they can't be remapped. Read by src/support.rs and website/tools/controllers.py.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-FLX4
controllers.note: Tried on the hardware; the mapping is still settling.

controllers.name: Numark V7
controllers.note: Mixxx's mapping from 2012. The V7 runs its own platter motor; the picture is a sketch, not measured.

controllers.name: Numark NS4FX
controllers.note: Mixxx's mapping, with its four decks and the jog screens. The pad mode buttons' second press (Pitch Play, Roll, Slicer, Scratch Banks) now works on every deck.

controllers.name: Numark DJ2GO2 Touch
controllers.note: Mixxx's mapping. Hold PAD MODE in Cues mode and press a pad to delete its hot cue.

controllers.name: Numark Mixstream Pro
controllers.note: Mixxx's mapping, for the Mixstream Pro, Pro+ and Pro Go in Computer Mode (Control Center › Source › computer). The touchscreen stays on its own Computer Mode screen.

controllers.name: Numark Party Mix
controllers.note: Mixxx's mapping for the first Party Mix. For the Party Mix MKII and Party Mix Live, pick Numark Party Mix MKII.

controllers.name: Numark Party Mix MKII
controllers.note: For the Party Mix MKII and Party Mix Live: the first Party Mix's mapping with their own pad mode buttons, touch jog wheels and filter knobs. The Live's light show isn't mapped.

controllers.name: Numark Scratch
controllers.note: Mixxx's mapping for the two-channel scratch mixer. Set a channel's input switch to PC to play an openDJ deck through it.

controllers.name: Allen & Heath Xone:K2
controllers.file: Allen and Heath Xone K2 - 2 Decks.opendj-mapping
controllers.note: openDJ's own two-deck mapping. Set the K2 to its factory settings: Latching Layers off, MIDI channel 15. openDJ's Mixer mapping (Allen & Heath Xone:K2 - Mixer) puts Mixer channels 1 to 4 on its columns, and Mixxx's mapping (Allen&Heath Xone K1/K2/K3) is still there to pick.

controllers.name: DJ TechTools Midi Fighter Twister
controllers.note: Tried on the hardware; the mapping is still settling.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-SX
controllers.note: Mixxx's mapping. Four decks; the pads have Hot Cue, Roll, Slicer and Sampler modes.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-SX2
controllers.note: Mixxx's DDJ-SX mapping: the SX2 sends the same MIDI. CAPTURE and the sequencer buttons do nothing yet.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-RX
controllers.note: Mixxx's DDJ-SX mapping plus QUANTIZE: the RX sends the SX2's MIDI. PAD FX mode plays rolls. The Sound Color FX buttons, CAPTURE and the sequencer buttons do nothing yet; the COLOR knobs work as filters.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-RB
controllers.note: openDJ's DDJ-400 mapping moved to the RB's messages: hot cues, pad FX, sampler, beat jump and both FX units; SLICER pads play loop rolls and SLICER LOOP pads set beat loops. SEQUENCE CALL does nothing yet.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-RR
controllers.note: openDJ's DDJ-RX mapping, keeping the messages the RR sends. The Sound Color FX buttons, CAPTURE and the sequencer do nothing yet.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-RZ
controllers.note: openDJ's DDJ-RX mapping: the RZ sends the RX's MIDI, and pressing BROWSE moves between the library panes. The Sound Color FX buttons, OSCILLATOR, USB A/B and the sequencer do nothing yet.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-RZX
controllers.note: openDJ's DDJ-RX mapping: the RZX sends the RX's MIDI for its decks and mixer. The screens, the video and touch strip controls, the Sound Color FX buttons, OSCILLATOR and the sequencer do nothing yet.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-SZ
controllers.note: Mixxx's DDJ-SX mapping: the SZ sends the SX2's MIDI apart from the browser. The Sound Color FX buttons, OSCILLATOR, USB A/B and the velocity sampler do nothing yet; the COLOR FX knobs work as filters.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-ERGO
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping, written from rekordbox's list of the ERGO's messages; AlphaTheta no longer publishes its MIDI list, so its picture is a sketch.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-WeGO
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping, written from rekordbox's list of the WeGO's messages; its picture is a sketch. The BEAT knobs do nothing yet.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-WeGO2
controllers.note: The WeGO mapping: the WeGO2 sends the same MIDI. Its picture is a sketch.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-WeGO3
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping, written from AlphaTheta's MIDI message list.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-WeGO4
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping, written from AlphaTheta's MIDI message list.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-FLX6
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping, written from Pioneer's MIDI message list.

controllers.name: Pioneer XDJ-RX3
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping for the all-in-one in PC control mode, written from AlphaTheta's MIDI message list.

controllers.name: Pioneer XDJ-AZ
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping for the all-in-one in PC control mode, built on the XDJ-RX3 mapping from AlphaTheta's MIDI message list.

controllers.name: Pioneer OPUS-QUAD
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping for the all-in-one in PC control mode, built on the XDJ-AZ mapping from AlphaTheta's MIDI message list. The pads play hot cues; the touch screen keeps the OPUS-QUAD's own PC-mode screen.

controllers.name: Pioneer XDJ-RX
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping for the all-in-one in PC control mode, written from AlphaTheta's MIDI message list and rekordbox's mapping of it. SLICER pads, MEMORY, DELETE and TIME MODE do nothing yet; the picture is a sketch, not measured.

controllers.name: Pioneer XDJ-RX2
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping for the all-in-one in PC control mode, written from rekordbox's mapping of it. KEYBOARD, KEY SHIFT and PAD FX2 pads do nothing yet; the picture is a sketch, not measured.

controllers.name: Pioneer XDJ-RR
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping for the all-in-one in PC control mode, written from rekordbox's mapping of it. The picture is a sketch, not measured.

controllers.name: Pioneer XDJ-XZ
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping for the all-in-one in PC control mode, written from AlphaTheta's MIDI message list and rekordbox's mapping of it. The XDJ-XZ's own mixer and Beat FX do the mixing. The picture is a sketch, not measured.

controllers.name: Pioneer XDJ-AERO
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping for the all-in-one in PC control mode, written from rekordbox's mapping of it. Each deck's FX section runs an openDJ effect unit. The picture is a sketch, not measured.

controllers.name: Pioneer XDJ-R1
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping for the all-in-one in PC control mode, written from rekordbox's mapping of it. Each deck's FX section runs an openDJ effect unit. The picture is a sketch, not measured.

controllers.name: Pioneer XDJ-AN
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping for the all-in-one in PC control mode, written from rekordbox's mapping of it. The picture is a sketch, not measured.

controllers.name: AlphaTheta OMNIS-DUO
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping for the portable all-in-one in PC control mode, written from AlphaTheta's MIDI message list and rekordbox's mapping of it. The pads play hot cues. The picture is a sketch, not measured.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-REV1
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping, written from Pioneer's MIDI message list.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-1000
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping, written from Pioneer's MIDI message list. The jog screens stay dark: they need Pioneer's own protocol.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-FLX10
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping, written from AlphaTheta's MIDI message list on top of the DDJ-FLX6's. The jog displays show the playhead, cue, BPM and time; with the jog screens HID mapping beside it, the track's waveform too (not yet tried on the hardware). MIX POINT, FX PART SELECT and the pad PAGE buttons do nothing yet.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-GRV6
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping, written from AlphaTheta's MIDI message list on top of the DDJ-FLX6's. GROOVE CIRCUIT works on the deck's drum stems; CAPTURE fills an open Looper deck. CUE/LOOP MEMORY and MASTER CUE do nothing yet.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-800
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping, written from Pioneer's MIDI message list on top of the DDJ-FLX4's. The jog displays show BPM, time and the playhead. MEMORY, DELETE, the pad PAGE buttons and the COLOR FX buttons do nothing yet.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-FLX2
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping, written from AlphaTheta's MIDI message list on top of the DDJ-FLX4's. Pads play HOT CUE, PAD FX, BEAT LOOP and SAMPLER. SMART CFX and SMART FADER do nothing yet; the CFX knobs work as filters.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-REV5
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping, written from AlphaTheta's MIDI message list on top of the DDJ-FLX6's, plus the REV5's KEY LOCK, SLIP, CENSOR, KEY and loop buttons. STEMS, the PIANO PLAY pad mode, TEMPO RANGE, the FX unit buttons and the BPM transition buttons do nothing yet.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-REV7
controllers.note: The REV7's motorized platters and jog screens need their own mapping; its MIDI follows Serato's layout, not the other Pioneer controllers'.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-SR
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping: Mixxx's DDJ-SX script, moved to the DDJ-SR's MIDI from Pioneer's message list. Four decks; the pads have Hot Cue, Roll, Slicer and Sampler modes. NEEDLE SEARCH does nothing yet.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-SP1
controllers.note: An add-on beside another controller. Mixxx's DDJ-SX script moved to the SP1's MIDI from Pioneer's message list: pads, FX, loops and SYNC for decks 1-4. NEEDLE SEARCH and turning AUTO LOOP do nothing yet.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-XP1
controllers.note: An add-on beside another controller. openDJ's own mapping, written from AlphaTheta's MIDI message list on top of the DDJ-FLX6's: 16 pads per deck (hot cues 1-16), pad modes, loops and deck select. SLIDE FX does nothing yet.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-XP2
controllers.note: An add-on beside another controller. openDJ's own mapping, written from AlphaTheta's MIDI message list on top of the DDJ-FLX6's: 16 pads per deck (hot cues 1-16), pad modes, loops and deck select. SLIDE FX does nothing yet.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-SB
controllers.note: Mixxx's mapping. Two decks; the pads have Hot Cue, Auto Loop, Manual Loop and Sampler modes.

controllers.name: Pioneer DDJ-SB2
controllers.note: Mixxx's mapping. Four decks (DECK 3 and DECK 4 switch); the pads have Hot Cue, Auto Loop, Manual Loop and Sampler modes, with Roll, Cue Loop and Bank on SHIFT.

controllers.name: Native Instruments Traktor Kontrol S2 MK3
controllers.note: A USB HID controller. Plays like Traktor: SAMPLES plays stems on a track with stems, hold GRID and turn the wheel to move the grid. It can't be remapped in the Controller Editor.

controllers.name: Native Instruments Traktor Kontrol S3
controllers.note: A USB HID controller. Plays like Traktor: SAMPLES plays stems on a track with stems, hold GRID and turn the wheel to move the grid. It can't be remapped in the Controller Editor.

controllers.name: Native Instruments Traktor Kontrol S4 MK3
controllers.note: A USB HID controller. Plays like Traktor: 8 hot cues, STEMS mutes stems on the top pads. Its two screens stay dark, and it can't be remapped in the Controller Editor.

controllers.name: Native Instruments Traktor MX2
controllers.note: A USB HID controller. Plays like Traktor's HOTCUES, STEMS and LOOPS pad modes; PATTERNS does nothing yet. It can't be remapped in the Controller Editor.

controllers.name: Native Instruments Maschine Mikro MK3
controllers.note: openDJ's own HID mapping for the Groove Box: steps, live play and recording, grooves and kits on the pads, with its screen. No NI software needed; quit Maschine first. No picture in the Controller Editor.

controllers.name: Pioneer DJM-250MK2
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping for the mixer beside openDJ (External mixer): the channel faders, crossfader and INPUT SELECT tell openDJ which decks the room hears; the mixer does the mixing. The picture is a sketch at the mixer's size, not measured.

controllers.name: Pioneer DJM-450
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping for the mixer beside openDJ (External mixer): the channel faders, crossfader and INPUT SELECT tell openDJ which decks the room hears; the mixer does the mixing. The picture is a sketch at the mixer's size, not measured.

controllers.name: Pioneer DJM-750MK2
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping for the mixer beside openDJ (External mixer): the channel faders, crossfader, crossfader assign and INPUT SELECT tell openDJ which decks the room hears; the mixer does the mixing. The picture is a sketch at the mixer's size, not measured.

controllers.name: Pioneer DJM-900NXS2
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping for the mixer beside openDJ (External mixer): the channel faders, crossfader, crossfader assign and INPUT SELECT tell openDJ which decks the room hears; the mixer does the mixing. The picture is a sketch at the mixer's size, not measured.

controllers.name: Pioneer DJM-A9
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping for the mixer beside openDJ (External mixer): the channel faders, crossfader, crossfader assign and INPUT SELECT tell openDJ which decks the room hears; the mixer does the mixing. The picture is a sketch at the mixer's size, not measured.

controllers.name: Pioneer DJM-V10
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping for the mixer beside openDJ (External mixer): the faders of channels 1 to 4, the crossfader, crossfader assign and INPUT SELECT tell openDJ which decks the room hears; the mixer does the mixing. The picture is a sketch at the mixer's size, not measured. Channels 5 and 6 aren't mapped.

controllers.name: Pioneer DJM-V5
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping for the mixer beside openDJ (External mixer): the channel faders and INPUT SELECT tell openDJ which decks the room hears; the mixer does the mixing. The picture is a sketch at the mixer's size, not measured.

controllers.name: Pioneer DJM-TOUR1
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping for the mixer beside openDJ (External mixer): the channel faders, crossfader, crossfader assign and INPUT SELECT tell openDJ which decks the room hears; the mixer does the mixing. The picture is a sketch at the mixer's size, not measured.

controllers.name: AlphaTheta euphonia
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping for the mixer beside openDJ (External mixer): the rotary channel volumes and INPUT SELECT tell openDJ which decks the room hears; the mixer does the mixing. The picture is a sketch at the mixer's size, not measured.

controllers.name: Pioneer DJM-S9
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping, written from AlphaTheta's MIDI message list. Browser, loops, pads (hot cue, roll, sampler, beat jump), FX levers and faders; the mixer does the mixing. The picture follows AlphaTheta's top-view drawing.

controllers.name: Pioneer DJM-S7
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping, written from the mixer's MIDI messages. Browser, loops, pads (hot cue, roll, sampler), FX levers and faders; the mixer does the mixing. The picture is a sketch, not measured.

controllers.name: Pioneer DJM-S11
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping, written from the mixer's MIDI messages. Browser, loops, pads (hot cue, roll, sampler), FX levers and faders; the mixer does the mixing. The touch screen keeps its own screen. The picture is a sketch, not measured.

controllers.name: Pioneer DJM-T1
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping, written from the mixer's MIDI messages. Decks, loops, hot cue and sampler pads, two effect units and faders; the mixer does the mixing. The picture is a sketch, not measured.

controllers.name: Pioneer DJ PLX-CRSS12
controllers.note: openDJ's own mapping for the turntable's performance pads (hot cue, sampler, roll, beat jump). The platter doesn't control openDJ yet: it needs the turntable's own protocol; use it with timecode vinyl. The picture is a sketch, not measured.
